assumptions.signal_timestamp: After each signal date close; NYSE session date, 16:00 ET convention.
assumptions.execution: At the next available session open; NYSE session date, 09:30 ET convention.
assumptions.slippage: Adverse percentage adjustment to reference execution price.
assumptions.transaction_cost: Percentage fee charged on each executed trade notional.
assumptions.position_sizing: Long only; target fraction of account equity; fractional shares allowed.
assumptions.end_of_test: Any open position is liquidated at the last close with costs.
assumptions.scope: Expanding walk-forward development folds only; final chronological 20% holdout excluded.
assumptions.position_rules: Long only; buy enters while flat, sell exits while invested, hold retains; no shorting.
assumptions.last_test_signal: Included in audit; excluded from execution because no next open remains in-window.
assumptions.adaptive_weight_timing: Weights are frozen from the preceding fold validation window for the upcoming test fold; test labels never select their own weights.

limitations: Historical point-in-time news is unavailable; the sentiment component is neutral in every row.
The LSTM may use the evaluator's documented neutral fallback when TensorFlow training is unavailable or insufficient.
Only expanding walk-forward development test rows are executed; the final 20% holdout is excluded.
Daily Yahoo adjusted OHLCV cannot model intraday path, spreads, market impact, partial fills, taxes, or borrow costs.
Fractional shares, fixed proportional transaction costs, and fixed slippage are simplified assumptions.
The comparison covers the requested symbol and historical window; results do not establish future profitability.
Adaptive weights use one preceding validation window per fold; regime-specific validation samples may be too small and trigger an overall-validation fallback.
Historical FinBERT news is unavailable, so sentiment receives no adaptive historical weight; the fixed control retains its documented neutral contribution.
